claim_details.claim: Cardiac biomarkers are substances that enter the bloodstream when the heart is damaged or stressed they are used to diagnose and monitor heart conditions

Additional markers that have been used over time include aspartate aminotransferase (AST), lactate dehydrogenase (LD) myoglobin, though many of these are less specific and are used less frequently in modern clinical practice
